Helm — QA & Regression Checklist

A living pre-release checklist. Run Part A (functional smoke tests) after any code change to confirm nothing broke; run Part B (scenario tests) to confirm the engine still proposes sane trades under defined market regimes. Checks persist in your browser — tick them as you go.
Regression suite · v1
How to use. Part A is mechanical — click through each tab and confirm the "expected" column. Part B is judgment: trigger the regime (in real markets or by reasoning through current data), then check the engine's proposals against the ✓ expected / ✕ fail-if lists. A single ✕ is a real regression — the model is doing something a competent PM wouldn't. Reset per run with Clear all.

Part B · Scenario tests — does the engine stay sane? 0

Pandemic-crash onset

Mar-2020-like: fast −30% draw, VIX spike, liquidity injection incoming
Trigger signals
  • Regime flips to risk-off / crisis
  • Net liquidity turning up (Fed backstop)
  • Breadth collapses; trend gate broken market-wide
Engine should
  • Go defensive: trim high-beta, raise cash
  • Crypto stance = WAIT (no alt buys)
  • Flag quality names getting cheap for later accumulation, not buy-now
Fail if
  • Buys falling knives because "price down = value"
  • Adds leverage / concentrates into the draw
  • DEPLOY on crypto mid-crash
Verified — engine stays defensive

Rate-hike cycle

2022-like: rising yields, duration punished, multiple compression
Trigger signals
  • 2y/10y rising; CPI hot
  • Regime = tightening; duration underweight
  • Growth/long-duration tech de-rating
Engine should
  • Tilt value / energy / quality, short duration
  • Trim unprofitable long-duration growth
  • Favor cash-flow positive over story stocks
Fail if
  • Loads unprofitable growth because it "fell a lot"
  • Ignores the rate regime entirely
Verified — value/quality tilt

Crypto winter / bear bottom

Post-blowoff: BTC −70%, cycle phase Markdown → Accumulation
Trigger signals
  • HelmCryptoCycle phase = Markdown/Accumulation
  • 4-yr halving clock early; net liquidity basing
Engine should
  • Stance DCA: BTC + majors only, gradual
  • No long-tail alt buys (low tier durability)
  • Size to the strategic crypto band floor, deploy later
Fail if
  • Proposes DOT / weak alts at the bottom (the bug we fixed)
  • All-in crypto, or crypto → 0
Verified — DCA majors, no alts

Euphoria melt-up

Late bull: parabolic, everyone long, breadth narrowing
Trigger signals
  • Crypto cycle = Euphoria; RSI extended market-wide
  • Valuation rich; sentiment maxed
Engine should
  • Stance DISTRIBUTE: trim strength, raise cash
  • Flip crypto buys to trims
  • Take profit into strength; tighten stops
Fail if
  • Chases momentum at the top
  • Adds risk because trend is "strong"
Verified — distributes, no chase

Stagflation

Sticky inflation + slowing growth; the hard regime
Trigger signals
  • CPI high, growth rolling over
  • Real yields volatile; USD bid
Engine should
  • Tilt energy / materials / gold, real assets
  • Avoid duration + unprofitable growth
  • Prefer pricing-power quality
Fail if
  • Piles into rate-sensitive growth
  • Treats it like a normal risk-off dip
Verified — real-asset tilt

Bank / credit event

SVB-like: sudden financials stress, contagion fear
Trigger signals
  • Financials gap down; credit spreads widen
  • Flight-to-quality bid in Treasuries
Engine should
  • Trim weak-balance-sheet financials (debt/equity, low current ratio)
  • Rotate to quality; respect the trend gate
  • Not treat the −20% bank as "cheap value"
Fail if
  • Buys the falling bank on valuation alone
  • Ignores real quality fundamentals now in the feed
Verified — quality screen holds

Soft-landing / risk-on

Disinflation + growth holds; the constructive regime
Trigger signals
  • CPI cooling, growth resilient
  • Regime = expansion / risk-on; breadth broad
Engine should
  • Deploy cash, momentum + growth tilt
  • Crypto stance DCA→DEPLOY as cycle confirms
  • Let winners run within risk budget
Fail if
  • Stays 100% defensive with strong tape
  • Won't deploy even when plan needs return
Verified — deploys within budget

US ⇄ Canada rotation

DXY + relative strength shifts leadership between markets
Trigger signals
  • SPX vs TSX 3–6mo relative strength flips
  • DXY trend + commodity backdrop shifts
Engine should
  • Shift CIO tilt between US growth and CA defensive/resources
  • Advisory, not forced — only when signal is real
Fail if
  • Ignores relative strength entirely (permanently US-only)
  • Flip-flops on noise every day
Verified — rotates on real signal
Reference · where each regime reads from
Regime / season
regime.jsx · Markov states → methods.jsx per-regime weights; Macro season strip validates against real data
Liquidity
macro.jsx · FRED net liquidity (WALCL−RRP−TGA) + Global M2 lens
Crypto stance
window.HelmCryptoCycle() · halving clock + net-liquidity → WAIT/DCA/DEPLOY/DISTRIBUTE, gates signalsFor()
Quality / value
fundamentals() (real Finnhub) for equities · cryptoFundamentals() (cycle + tier) for crypto
US vs CA tilt
ciomix.jsx · regime + DXY proxy + SPX-vs-TSX relative strength + net liquidity
Trend gate
strategy.jsx · no buying below trend (anti-falling-knife); RSI overbought-sell on short horizon only
Honest limits — what this suite does NOT prove
Scenario tests assert the engine reasons correctly given the data — they do not prove the data is right, nor that a proposed trade will make money. The engine runs on synthetic history for walk-forward and EOD/real feed for live scoring; Canadian names are EOD-only. No broker execution, no model retraining — this validates the harness and the decision logic, which is where a bad regression would show up first. Re-run Part A on every code change; re-run Part B whenever the regime shifts or you touch strategy.jsx / ciomix.jsx / regime.jsx.
